title: The Fragility of the Urban Advantage: Replication Code
description: R code to reproduce the results of "The Fragility of the Urban Advantage: Vulnerability to Food Insecurity under Systemic Shocks". Analysis of FAO Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) data for Ethiopia (2014–2023): Rasch models, prevalence trends, and survey-weighted logistic regressions of the urban–rural food insecurity gap during systemic shocks. The FIES microdata are not included and are available from the FAO Microdata Catalogue (https://microdata.fao.org).
